name: Amber Stoneware Vase
description:
A warm amber vessel with a quiet, tapered neck. Thrown by hand and finished with a soft matte glaze that catches morning light.

Ideal for a few stems or a single branch — the silhouette does the rest.
care: Wipe with a damp cloth. Not for dishwasher use.

name: Sage Cylinder Vase
description:
A calm cylindrical form in mist sage. The glaze is intentionally quiet so flowers and branches stay the focus.

Each piece is handmade; slight variations in tone are part of the craft.
care: Hand wash gently. Avoid sudden temperature changes.

name: Linen Bud Vase
description: A small linen-toned bud vase for a single stem or dried grass. Compact enough for a desk or bedside table.

name: Olive Wide-Mouth Vase
description: A wider mouth for fuller arrangements. The olive ink glaze sits deep and soft against natural light.
care: Hand wash only. Dry thoroughly before storing.

name: Clay Blush Bottle Vase
description: A slender bottle silhouette with a soft clay-blush wash. Quiet ornament for shelves and windowsills.

name: Seagrass Market Basket
description: A sturdy woven market basket with twin handles. Soft natural seagrass that ages beautifully with everyday use.
care: Shake out debris. Spot clean with a damp cloth.

name: Raffia Round Bowl
description: A low, round bowl for fruit, keys, or small textiles. Tight weave with a calm linen presence.
care: Keep dry. Wipe with a soft cloth.

name: Coil-Weave Storage Basket
description: Tall coil weaving for blankets or laundry. Sage-tinted accent bands woven into the natural base.

name: Woven Serving Tray
description: A shallow tray with side handles — for tea service or gathering small objects on a table.
care: Wipe dry after use. Do not soak.

name: Mini Nest Basket
description: A small nest for jewelry or desktop odds. Soft coil, palm-sized, and easy to gift.
care: Dust lightly. Keep away from direct rain.
